workflows.title: LiPo protection ON
workflows.summary: Enable Low-Voltage Detection before using a LiPo battery.
workflows.warning: Never use a LiPo battery while Low-Voltage Detection is disabled. Solid green means LiPo protection ON; solid red means it is OFF.
steps: Turn on the TQi transmitter and leave the throttle at neutral.
Connect the charged LiPo battery and switch the VXL-3m on.
Check the ESC LED. If it is already solid green, Low-Voltage Detection is active and you are done.
If the LED is solid red, press and hold EZ-Set for about 10 seconds.
The LED will switch off and then light green; the motor emits a rising musical tone.
Release the button. Low-Voltage Detection is now active.
workflows.result: Solid GREEN VXL-3m LED = Low-Voltage Detection active (LiPo setting).

workflows.title: NiMH mode / LiPo protection OFF
workflows.summary: Disable Low-Voltage Detection when returning to NiMH.
workflows.warning: Only disable Low-Voltage Detection for NiMH use. Do not drive a LiPo battery in this mode.
steps: Turn on the transmitter and switch the VXL-3m on.
Confirm the ESC LED is solid green.
Press and hold EZ-Set for about 10 seconds.
The LED will switch off and then light red; the motor emits a falling musical tone.
Release the button. Low-Voltage Detection is now disabled.
workflows.result: Solid RED VXL-3m LED = Low-Voltage Detection disabled (NiMH setting).

workflows.title: Training mode 50%
workflows.summary: Limit forward and reverse power to 50% while keeping full braking.
steps: Connect a charged battery and turn on the TQi transmitter.
Leave the VXL-3m switched off.
Press and hold EZ-Set. The LED turns solid green, then solid red, then begins blinking red.
Release EZ-Set immediately after THREE red blinks.
The ESC stores Profile 3 and is ready to drive.
workflows.result: Profile 3: 50% forward, 100% brakes, 50% reverse. Final LED remains green for LiPo mode or red for NiMH mode.

workflows.title: Return to full power
workflows.summary: Switch back from Training mode to normal Sport mode.
steps: Connect a charged battery and turn on the TQi transmitter.
Leave the VXL-3m switched off.
Press and hold EZ-Set until the red profile blink sequence begins.
Release EZ-Set after ONE red blink.
The ESC stores Profile 1 and returns to full-power Sport mode.

workflows.title: Set TSM traction/stability assist
workflows.summary: Adjust how strongly Traxxas Stability Management corrects the car on low-grip surfaces.
steps: Use the Multi-Function knob on the TQi transmitter; from the factory it controls TSM.
Start at the recommended 12:00 position.
Turn clockwise for more assistance on loose dirt, smooth concrete, ice or snow.
Turn counterclockwise for less assistance and a looser, more slide-friendly feel.
Turn fully counterclockwise to the stop to switch TSM completely off.
workflows.warning: Turn TSM completely off before adjusting steering trim. TSM is automatically inactive while driving or braking in reverse.
workflows.result: 12:00 = recommended baseline; clockwise = more assistance; fully counterclockwise = TSM off.

workflows.title: Wheel alignment: toe + camber
workflows.summary: Make the wheels point straight from above and set their vertical lean from the front/rear.
workflows.warning: Toe and camber interact on this suspension. Make small adjustments, keep left/right settings symmetrical, and always re-check toe after changing camber. Factory camber is -2° front and rear, so the wheel tops normally lean slightly inward; perfectly vertical (0°) is not the factory setting.
steps: Install a battery and place the car at normal ride height on a flat surface. Turn TSM fully off and set steering trim to neutral before judging the front wheels.

TOE = viewed from above. If both front wheels point left or right together, correct steering trim first. If their front edges point toward each other, that is toe-in; if they point apart, that is toe-out.
Use the supplied 2 mm hex wrench in the suspension pivot balls at the axle carrier. For toe, adjust the UPPER and LOWER pivot balls by the same amount so camber changes as little as possible.

Turn both pivot balls CLOCKWISE into the suspension arm to increase toe-in. Turn both COUNTERCLOCKWISE out of the arm to reduce toe-in. For a visually straight neutral setup, aim for the wheels to be parallel when viewed from above.
Rear toe is adjusted the same way. Avoid rear toe-out; a little rear toe-in improves stability.
CAMBER = viewed from the front or rear. Negative camber means the tops of the tires lean inward. Positive camber means the tops lean outward.

To move from the factory -2° camber toward a more vertical 0° wheel, unthread the UPPER pivot ball slightly with the 2 mm hex. To increase negative camber, unthread the LOWER pivot ball. Work in small equal increments left and right.
Set the car back down at normal ride height after every adjustment. Use a small square against the wheel if you want to check 0° vertical camber accurately.
Finally look from above again and re-check toe, because changing camber also changes toe on the E-Revo pivot-ball suspension.
workflows.result: Above: wheels can be set parallel for a neutral 0° toe reference. Front/rear: factory camber is -2° each side; 0° looks perfectly vertical but is not the factory setup.
